title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The final expression for capacitance per unit length must be correctly stated as C = pi / ln(2b/a).

title: Potential Difference
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of the potential difference V between the wire and the image wire must be correctly derived.

title: Image Charge Method
description: Important Criteria: The use of the image charge method to account for the metal plane must be clearly explained.

title: Logarithmic Terms
description: Optional Criteria: The logarithmic terms in the potential expressions should be correctly simplified and interpreted.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any errors in maintaining consistent units throughout the calculations will result in a deduction.
